papers.title: The parity barrier and twin primes: what is known and what is missing
papers.summary: Frozen v1.0 (18 Nov 2026, 24 pp.); v1.0.1 (20 Nov 2026) adds only a status note: the preprint arXiv:2610.20242 (Lu-Wang-Wu) claims sum_p mu(p+2) = o(pi(x)), called open in the paper; Claimed, not verified. Survey of the obstacle between bounded gaps and twin primes, read in the sources, with own results, each labelled: window form of Tao's convex-hull criterion (Liouville-pattern weights block a proof of H_m <= g exactly when g < H(2m+1); a statement about the weight class, not a bound); GEH ceilings, k = 2 exactly at the parity value 2, the k = 3 criterion above 2 at eps = 2/9, 1/4, 7/24 and provably below 2 for eps >= 0.439; Pintz's dichotomy with Maynard weights (|d| <= 12; Pintz 16; possibly folklore); consistency tests; why Gowers norms and averages over the shift stop at the mean gap; asymptotic sieves for Lambda(n+2); F_q[T], a^2+b^4, x^3+2y^3; the Siegel-zero world.
